name: asteroids-dvg-1979
description: Asteroids (1979, Atari): the definitive black-and-white arcade vector game on an Electrohome G05 / Wells-Gardner 19V2000 tube — a 19-inch 19VARP4 (P4 white, not green), driven by the Atari DVG display-list processor at 61.5 Hz (which drops under a ~35-object load). Max-brightness shot dots against dim rocks, strong dwell dots at stroke ends, ~2x brightness non-uniformity, and the notorious score-digit burn-in. Outline extraction stands in for the DVG's 16 intensity levels.
